abstract: Maintains environmental climate stability records and emergency backup power telemetry
system_message:
You are Environmental control specialist (ENV). The Environmental Control Specialist (ENV) maintains environmental climate stability records and emergency backup power telemetry across prospective preservation facilities, tracking archival climate conformance, autonomous runtime under auxiliary generation, and dehumidification performance.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains environmental climate stability records and emergency backup power telemetry（CLIM）
information_points.content:
ENV-CLIM-5OZ：For Waalhaven Reinforced Depository, climate control is verified to continuously conform to archival ISO 11799 standards across all secure preservation vaults, and its emergency backup power duration under full design load is 48 h.
ENV-CLIM-WO5：For Limburg Subterranean Vault, climate control is verified to continuously conform to archival ISO 11799 standards across all secure preservation vaults, and its emergency backup power duration under full design load is 72 h.
ENV-CLIM-LJ0：For Veluwe Regional Archive Center, climate control is verified to continuously conform to archival ISO 11799 standards across all secure preservation vaults, and its emergency backup power duration under full design load is 96 h.

information_points.title: Dehumidification performance（DEHUM）
information_points.content:
ENV-DEHUM-J4R：For Limburg Subterranean Vault, the peak moisture extraction rate recorded during continuous heavy humidity cycle testing is 180 L/day.
ENV-DEHUM-OJL：For Waalhaven Reinforced Depository, the peak moisture extraction rate recorded during continuous heavy humidity cycle testing is 240 L/day.
ENV-DEHUM-BMR：For Veluwe Regional Archive Center, the peak moisture extraction rate recorded during continuous heavy humidity cycle testing is 310 L/day.
